company.name: Fig
company.shortDescription: Fig adds visual apps, shortcuts, and autocomplete to your terminal.
company.description:
Fig makes the terminal more accessible to beginners, more efficient for advanced engineers, and more collaborative for teams. It is building an app store ecosystem for the terminal. Its first app is autocomplete.

Fig was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
